description: Shared fixtures for the MCP output sanitizer. Canonical copy: SecID-Service test/fixtures/mcp-sanitize-fixtures.json; SecID-Server-API keeps an identical copy at python/fixtures/mcp-sanitize-fixtures.json. Both implementations must turn each `input` into exactly `expected` (objects compared without regard to key order). fn: response = sanitizeResponseForMcp / sanitize_response_for_mcp; record = sanitizeRecordForMcp / sanitize_record_for_mcp.
